families.label: Flock Safety Cameras
families.attention: Roadside camera match. IEEE B4:1E:52 or a Flock, FLCK, Condor, Falcon, or Sparrow name. A module vendor OUI is not this row.
families.notes: Name and the Flock OUI only. Company 0x09C8 is the Penguin battery row.

families.label: Penguin
families.attention: Flock-family external battery (XUNTONG 0x09C8), not the acoustic sensor.
families.notes: Company ID 0x09C8 or a Penguin name. Raven keeps its own names, UUIDs, and OUI.

families.label: Raven / ShotSpotter
families.notes: Names, service UUIDs 3100-3500, or OUI D4:11:D6. Not company 0x09C8.

families.label: Securitas Direct / Verisure
families.attention: Verisure / Securitas Direct central unit Wi-Fi (Spain 58:B5:68, Nordic 24:C3:F9, 00:23:C1). Often a single 32-character random SSID, not a brand name.
families.notes: Match on panel BSSID OUI. WPA2-PSK; WPS usually off. SSID alone is not unique enough without the OUI.

families.label: Apple AirTags
families.notes: Find My protocol, an AirTag name, or service FD44. Dropped when an Apple phone or audio row also matches, unless the name says AirTag or FD44 is present.

families.label: iPhone
families.notes: The name says iPhone. A continuity frame on the protocol line is the advertisement, not a second device.

families.label: OPPO smartphone
families.notes: OPPO handset name. Accessory families such as Enco, Watch, and Pad are intentionally excluded.

families.label: Samsung smartphone
families.notes: Samsung Galaxy phone hotspot or an explicit Galaxy Z Fold model name.

families.label: HONOR smartphone
families.notes: HONOR Magic-series smartphone name, including observed MAGI spelling.

families.label: Caterpillar smartphone
families.notes: Caterpillar rugged smartphone identified by the CATBINT Bluetooth or GATT model name.

families.label: iPad
families.notes: The name says iPad.

families.label: Mac
families.notes: The name says MacBook, iMac, or Mac mini.

families.label: Apple TV
families.notes: The name says Apple TV. Nearby Action on the protocol line is the continuity frame.

families.label: Apple Watch
families.notes: The name says Apple Watch.

families.label: HomePod
families.notes: The name says HomePod, or the model is an AudioAccessory identifier (HomePod and HomePod mini).

families.label: Apple Device
families.notes: Continuity frame only. The protocol line names it. Class is Ambiguous until the name says phone, TV, watch, or Mac.

families.label: Apple audio
families.notes: Proximity pairing, AirPlay target, an AirPods or Beats name, or an AirPods, Beats, or Powerbeats board id. Device1 ids are included only when that Bluetooth product id is a published headphone.

families.label: DULT tracker
families.notes: Service data FCB2 only. A bare UUID in the list does not match. Chipolo and Pebblebee can dual-label.

families.label: Google Find Hub
families.notes: FEAA frames 0x40 and 0x41 only. Eddystone UID, URL, and TLM stay off this row.

families.label: Chipolo
families.notes: Name match. A DULT frame on the same radio stays labeled too.

families.label: Projector
families.attention: Classroom / conference projector Wi‑Fi (PROJ… SSIDs, Epson-style ST-####XXX model names).
families.notes: Regex for fixed-width model tokens and PROJ… prefixes.

families.label: Television
families.notes: Many smart TVs advertise BLE as [TV] …, embed OLED in the model name, or use IPTV/set-top names (descodificador, …).

families.label: Windows PC
families.notes: Windows default Bluetooth discovery name DESKTOP-… (PC, laptop, or tablet).

families.label: Samsung TV
families.notes: Samsung-specific BLE names; generic [TV] … rows are also Television.

families.label: Bluetooth audio output
families.notes: Strong endpoint services only: headset, A2DP sink, hands-free headset, or hearing access. Source/gateway and generic media-control services are intentionally excluded.

families.label: Bluetooth video device
families.notes: Bluetooth Video Source, Video Sink, or Video Distribution service. Generic media control alone is not treated as a television.

families.label: TV / media device
families.notes: AVRCP target or A/V Remote Control profile. A television is possible, but speakers, headphones, phones, and computers can expose the same service.

families.label: Health monitor
families.notes: Bluetooth SIG physiological measurement or treatment service.

families.label: Fitness device
families.notes: Running, cycling, power, or fitness-machine service.

families.label: Human interface device
families.notes: Bluetooth HID or HID ISO service; may be a keyboard, mouse, controller, or remote.

families.label: Environmental sensor
families.notes: Environmental Sensing or Binary Sensor service.

families.label: Bluetooth network device
families.notes: PAN, network-access-point, IP support, or mesh-proxy service.

families.label: Bluetooth printer
families.notes: Bluetooth printing or hardcopy-cable-replacement service.

families.label: Speaker
families.notes: Bluetooth names containing Audio or Speaker.

families.label: Headphones
families.notes: Bluetooth names containing Buds, including Earbuds.

families.label: Sony headphones
families.notes: Sony LE_* local names and WH-/WF-C wireless audio. Company 0x012D is Sony Corporation.

families.label: Epson printer
families.notes: Epson WF-* printers only — not Sony LE_WF-* earbuds (WF-C510).

families.label: Bluetooth Mesh provisioner
families.notes: Mesh Provisioning Service 0x1827; often unnamed while a light/switch is being added to a mesh.

families.label: Samsung SmartTags
families.notes: SmartTag name or service FD5A. Company 0x0075 is Samsung Electronics, so a TV, phone, or watch with that ID is not this row.

families.label: Fast Pair
families.notes: UUID FE2C. A 3-byte model id is pairing mode. A longer account-key frame is crowd noise.

families.label: Tesla
families.notes: Phone-as-key uses an Apple iBeacon layout with Tesla's UUID. That row wins over generic iBeacon.

families.label: DIGI
families.notes: DIGI home-router default SSIDs.

families.label: Movistar
families.notes: Movistar home-router default SSIDs.

families.label: Orange
families.notes: Orange home-router default SSIDs, including Livebox.

families.label: Vodafone
families.notes: Vodafone home-router default SSIDs, including Smartbox and Vodafone Station.

families.label: Jazztel
families.notes: Jazztel home-router default SSIDs.

families.label: O2
families.notes: O2 home-router default SSIDs.

families.label: MasMovil
families.attention: MIWIFI_* is associated in Spain with ZTE routers supplied by the MásMóvil group; treat this as an SSID-based hypothesis.
families.notes: MásMóvil home-router default SSIDs. MIWIFI_* is assigned here rather than to the router manufacturer.

families.label: Yoigo
families.notes: Yoigo home-router default SSIDs.

families.label: Pepephone
families.notes: Pepephone home-router default SSIDs.

families.label: MiFibra
families.notes: MiFibra home-router default SSIDs.

families.label: Lowi
families.notes: Lowi home-router default SSIDs.

families.label: Iberdrola
families.notes: Iberdrola connectivity equipment SSIDs.

families.label: Calima
families.notes: Calima home-router default SSIDs.

families.label: Sagemcom
families.notes: Router-vendor SSIDs that identify Sagemcom, not a specific ISP.

families.label: Sercomm
families.notes: Router-vendor SSIDs that identify Sercomm, not a specific ISP.

families.label: TP-Link
families.notes: TP-Link home-router default SSIDs.

families.label: Tenda
families.notes: Tenda home-router default SSIDs.

families.label: ZTE
families.notes: Router-vendor SSIDs that identify ZTE, not a specific ISP.

families.label: Generic ISP router
families.attention: The WLAN_* and REDWIFI* prefixes are not specific enough to attribute an operator.
families.notes: Generic ISP-style default SSIDs retained as Home router without a company attribution.

families.label: Hotel / lodging
families.attention: Hotel or lodging SSID clue only; names can be user-defined.
families.notes: Hotels, hostels, motels, resorts and other short-stay accommodation.

families.label: Apartment
families.attention: Apartment or holiday-rental SSID clue only; names can be user-defined.
families.notes: Apartments and apartment complexes.

families.label: Restaurant
families.attention: Restaurant or dining-venue SSID clue only; names can be user-defined.
families.notes: Restaurants, bistros and dining venues.

families.label: Café / lounge
families.attention: Café, terrace or lounge SSID clue only; names can be user-defined.
families.notes: Cafés, cafeterias, terraces and lounge-style venues.

families.label: Workspace / coworking
families.attention: Workspace or coworking SSID clue only; names can be user-defined.
families.notes: Coworking spaces, shared workspaces and business centres.

families.label: Guest Wi-Fi
families.attention: Generic guest-network wording does not identify the venue type.
families.notes: Guest Wi-Fi whose venue type cannot be inferred from the SSID.

families.label: Wi-Fi Direct printer
families.attention: Wi-Fi Direct / setup SSID (HP DIRECT-xx-HP, Epson DIRECT-xxxxxxxx, EC520_*, pm_wireless_*, GPLUSPR_*, HS-######, …).
families.notes: Wi-Fi only. HP Wireless Direct uses HP-Print-xx-.

families.label: EnGenius cloud AP (setup)
families.attention: EnGenius ECW/EWS access point local management SSID before cloud onboarding (EnMGMT + last 4 of LAN MAC, often with -Initializing / -Cloud_ERR suffixes).

families.label: Robot vacuum / mop
families.attention: Floor-care and connected laundry setup Wi-Fi (Roomba, iRobot, Braava, Samsung Washer_*, [washer]_*).
families.notes: Wi-Fi setup SSIDs, BLE names, and iRobot company 0x0600. Robot APs are often short-lived during provisioning.

families.label: Dashcam Wi-Fi
families.attention: Dashcam AP or BLE radio (70mai company 0x0909, KAWA, CVR-*, E-ACE B46P, YantopCam-*, Meitrack MTDVR / MT-* fleet DVR).

families.label: Ai-Thinker ESP soft AP
families.attention: Factory ESP8266/ESP32 soft-AP SSID from Ai-Thinker modules (AI-THINKER_…).

families.label: LoRaWAN / LPWAN
families.attention: LoRaWAN gateways, sensors, and UART bridges seen on Wi‑Fi or BLE — not the LoRa radio itself.
families.notes: Wi‑Fi: gateway setup APs (RAK, Dragino, Kerlink, …). BLE/BT: node names and HC‑05/HC‑06 modules.

families.label: Trimble SNM941 gateway
families.notes: Trimble Connected Site gateway on construction / agriculture machines.
families.attention: Machine telematics and GNSS corrections — not a passenger-car infotainment hotspot.

families.label: Phone / tablet hotspot
families.attention: Phone or tablet cellular tethering. AOSP default SSIDs AndroidAP and AndroidShare (often AndroidAP_####) are Android phones/tablets, not routers. User names starting with Hotspot are common too.
families.notes: Wi-Fi only. Not Android Auto (AndroidAuto*). Car SSIDs such as Hotspot de … stay on the vehicle rows.

families.label: VAG infotainment hotspot
families.attention: VW Group in-car Wi-Fi (VW, Audi, Škoda, SEAT). MIB-style SSIDs; not a home ISP router.
families.notes: Prefer brand-specific regex. My * alone is too broad for catalog clues.

families.label: Android Auto Wi-Fi
families.attention: Head-unit or phone projection Wi-Fi for Android Auto.

families.label: Apple CarPlay Wi-Fi
families.attention: In-car Wi-Fi tied to CarPlay projection.

families.label: CHIGEE motorcycle display
families.attention: CHIGEE motorcycle display Wi-Fi used for Wireless CarPlay or Android Auto.
families.notes: CHIGEE documents CGHotsport-XXX as the automatic Wi-Fi link used for CarPlay mirroring.

families.label: Stellantis Uconnect
families.notes: FCA/Stellantis Uconnect Wi-Fi (Jeep, Peugeot, Citroën, Opel, etc.).

families.label: Hyundai / Kia in-car Wi-Fi
families.attention: Hyundai / Kia style infotainment hotspot SSIDs (common typo Hyunday in the field).

families.label: Toyota in-car Wi-Fi
families.attention: Toyota / Lexus style infotainment hotspot SSIDs.

families.label: Renault in-car Wi-Fi
families.attention: Renault R-Link / Share hotspot SSIDs.

families.label: Dacia in-car Wi-Fi
families.attention: Dacia Share infotainment hotspot SSID.

families.label: BYD vehicle
families.attention: BYD passenger EV Bluetooth name or hotspot / Wi-Fi Direct style SSID.

families.label: Generic vehicle
families.attention: The advertised name ends in the standalone word “car”; manufacturer is unknown.
families.notes: Generic fallback only. Brand-specific vehicle families remain more informative.

families.label: Car Wi-Fi dongle
families.attention: OBD / head-unit dongles (WirelessDongle, SmartDongle, AutoKit, …).

families.label: Pioneer car stereo
families.attention: Pioneer aftermarket head-unit Wi‑Fi (wireless CarPlay / Android Auto). SSID is often the model name (SPH-DA…).

families.label: iBeacon
families.notes: Apple iBeacon layout. Dropped when a non-beacon product already matched the same radio.

families.label: Osmo
families.notes: DJI company 0x08AA model ids 0x0006-0x0022, or an Osmo name. Aircraft ids stay on the DJI row.

families.label: DJI
families.attention: DJI radio. Osmo camera model ids are labeled Osmo instead.
families.notes: Company 0x08AA or a DJI name. Osmo prefixes are removed from this row after the match.

families.label: Remote ID aircraft
families.attention: Remote ID advertisement. Emergency is the stronger live state.
families.notes: BLE service FFFA, or Wi-Fi vendor IE FA:0B:BC or 6A:5C:35. WPA and RSN IEs are not a brand.

families.label: Ray-Ban / Meta glasses
families.attention: Ray-Ban, Meta View, or Oakley Meta name, or glasses service FEB7/FEB8. A Meta company ID alone is not this row.

families.label: Snap Spectacles
families.attention: Spectacles name or service FE45. A Snap company ID alone is not this row.

families.label: Vuzix
families.attention: Vuzix BLE glasses.

families.label: Axon
families.attention: Axon body-worn, in-car, dock, or TASER gear. OUI 00:25:DF is Axon Enterprise.
families.notes: BWCDEVICE is matched in service data, including the byte-reversed form, not only the advertised name.

families.label: Flipper Zero
families.attention: Flipper Devices BLE, or IEEE OUI 0C:FA:22.

families.label: Hak5 Pineapple
families.attention: Hak5 WiFi Pineapple setup or management AP.

families.label: Keyboard and mouse
families.notes: Keyboard and pointing-device family. Initially identifies Logitech MX Vertical by advertised name.

families.label: GoPro
families.notes: GoPro cameras identified by advertised name or standardized GATT manufacturer.

families.label: Pwnagotchi
families.attention: Pwnagotchi-style collector. Classic units use BSSID DE:AD:BE:EF:DE:AD.

families.label: Xiaomi Mi ColorS
families.notes: Xiaomi Mi ColorS handset. The spaced form Mi Color S is the same phone. Mi Band and Mi Watch stay on the wearable row.

families.label: iPod
families.notes: The name says iPod, or the model is an iPod touch board id.

families.label: Apple Vision Pro
families.notes: The name says Vision Pro, or the model is a RealityDevice board id.

families.label: Door lock
families.notes: Appearance subcategory Door lock, or a door-lock / smart-lock name. A branded lock row replaces this one.

families.label: Yale
families.notes: Bluetooth SIG company 0x0BDE.

families.label: Schlage
families.notes: Allegion company 0x013B and member service FCF4. Schlage is an Allegion brand.

families.label: August
families.notes: August Home company 0x01D1 and member service FE24. A bare month name is not this row.

families.label: ASSA ABLOY
families.notes: Bluetooth SIG company 0x012E and member service FCBF.

families.label: SALTO
families.notes: SALTO company 0x0199 and member service FE88.

families.label: ABUS
families.notes: Bluetooth SIG company 0x0CC4.

families.label: Sesame
families.notes: CANDY HOUSE company 0x055A and member service FD81. Sesame is that company's lock.

families.label: Tapkey
families.notes: Bluetooth SIG company 0x04FD and member service FD5E.

families.label: Arlo
families.notes: Arlo company 0x0C19. Arlotto is a different vendor and does not match this name.

families.label: Axis
families.notes: Wi-Fi vendor name Axis Communications, or a name that starts with AXIS.

families.label: Hikvision
families.notes: Wi-Fi vendor name. The OUI list is not copied into this row.

families.label: Verkada
families.notes: Member services FD3A and FD3B.

families.label: Rhombus
families.notes: Bluetooth SIG company 0x075D and member service FDA9.

families.label: Wyze
families.notes: Wyze Labs company 0x0870 and member service FD7B.

families.label: Insta360
families.notes: Advertised name. Insta GmbH and Instabeat are different companies and are not this row.

families.label: Garmin
families.notes: Garmin company 0x0087 and member service FE1F.

families.label: Polar
families.notes: Polar Electro companies 0x006B and 0x00D1, member services FEEF and FEEE.

families.label: Suunto
families.notes: Bluetooth SIG company 0x009F.

families.label: Wahoo
families.notes: Bluetooth SIG company 0x01FC.

families.label: Oura
families.notes: Oura company 0x02B2 and member services FDB0 and FDB1.

families.label: Withings
families.notes: Withings company 0x03FF. Watches and scales share this identifier.

families.label: Huami / Amazfit
families.notes: Huami companies 0x0157 and 0x022F, member services FEE0 and FEE1.

families.label: Aqara
families.notes: Lumi United company 0x0B27 and member service FCB9. A bare Lumi name is not this row.

families.label: Tuya
families.notes: Hangzhou Tuya company 0x07D0 and member service FD50. White-label modules use this identifier.

families.label: Shelly
families.notes: Allterco Robotics company 0x0BA9. Service FCD2 is BTHome and stays off this row.

families.label: Signify
families.notes: Signify company 0x060F and its member services. Koninklijke Philips 0x01DD is not this row.

families.label: Nest
families.notes: Nest Labs company 0x01B5 and member services FEB0 and FEAF.

families.label: ecobee
families.notes: Bluetooth SIG company 0x07D6.

families.label: Victron
families.notes: Victron Energy company 0x02E1.

families.label: SwitchBot
families.notes: Member service FD3D and the SwitchBot 128-bit service. No company identifier is used.

families.label: Eddystone
families.notes: FEAA frames 0x00, 0x10, 0x20, and 0x30. Find Hub frames 0x40 and 0x41 stay on that row.

families.label: Kontakt
families.notes: Kontakt company 0x01FD and member service FE6A.

families.label: Minew
families.notes: Advertised name. Company 0x0639 is shared with Minew sensor frames and is not this row.

families.label: Wiliot
families.notes: Wiliot company 0x0500 and member services FDAF, FCC6, and FC90.

families.label: Gimbal
families.notes: Gimbal company 0x008C and member services FEFD and FEFC. A name that merely contains gimbal is not this row.

families.label: Estimote
families.notes: Estimote company 0x015D and member service FE9A.

families.label: Volvo
families.notes: Volvo Car member services FD57 and FD58.

families.label: Rivian
families.notes: Bluetooth SIG company 0x0941.

families.label: GM
families.notes: General Motors company 0x0068 and member services FE47 and FE48. A bare GM token is not this row.

families.label: NIO
families.notes: NIO company 0x0B48 and member service FCDF.

families.label: Geotab
families.notes: Bluetooth SIG company 0x0275. Fleet telematics.

families.label: Samsara
families.notes: Samsara company 0x0B6B and its member services. Fleet telematics.

families.label: TPMS
families.notes: Schrader Electronics company 0x0601. Sensata is the Wi-Fi vendor name for the same sensors.

families.label: Parrot
families.notes: PARROT SA vendor name, or an ANAFI / Bebop / Parrot name. PARROT AUTOMOTIVE company 0x0043 is not this row.

families.label: Even Realities
families.notes: Advertised name. No company identifier is assigned to this row.

families.label: IXI
families.notes: Name is IXI or starts with IXI. A company identifier is not used.

families.label: Luxottica
families.notes: Luxottica company 0x0D53.
